title: Python
description: From your first print() to decorators, generators and interview patterns. Every lesson explains the mental model first, then the syntax, then the traps. Every practice question is tagged to the concepts it tests, so PyPrep can tell *why* you are stuck, not just that you are.

topics.title: Fundamentals
topics.description: Values, variables, types, operators, and talking to the user. The vocabulary everything else is built on.

lessons.title: What Python Is and How Programs Run

topics.title: Control Flow
topics.description: Decisions and repetition: if/elif/else, for and while loops, range, and the loop patterns that show up everywhere.

lessons.title: while Loops, break, continue and Nesting

topics.title: Strings
topics.description: Indexing, slicing (including the step), string methods, formatting and text-processing patterns.

topics.title: Collections
topics.description: Lists, tuples, sets and dictionaries, plus comprehensions and sorting.

topics.title: Functions
topics.description: Defining functions, parameters, scope, closures, recursion and higher-order functions.

topics.title: Object-Oriented Python
topics.description: Classes, encapsulation, inheritance, polymorphism, special methods and dataclasses.

topics.title: Advanced Python
topics.description: Exceptions, context managers, iterators, generators, decorators, complexity, interview patterns, typing and testing.
